evidence.title: Cline overview
evidence.finding: Cline documents distinct desktop, IDE, CLI, SDK and Kanban clients; model access has usage billing, ClinePass and own-key routes.

evidence.title: Cline Desktop
evidence.locator: Downloads; parallel sessions; imports; Schedule; SSH
evidence.finding: Desktop offers macOS and Windows beta, independent sessions, imported conversations and local or SSH execution.

evidence.title: Kanban core workflow
evidence.locator: Create; Link; Start; Review; Ship; Clean up
evidence.finding: Kanban cards have explicit dispatch, per-task worktrees, dependency chains, review feedback and prompt-driven commit/PR actions.

evidence.title: Checkpoints
evidence.finding: Editor checkpoints preserve file snapshots separately from Git and offer independent file and transcript restoration.

evidence.title: MCP
evidence.finding: Cline documents MCP server tools as extensions to its agent; no external call was executed.

evidence.title: cline pinned license
evidence.finding: The pinned repository LICENSE is Apache-2.0; this does not license every vendor-hosted service.

evidence.title: Cline Kanban
evidence.finding: Kanban is explicitly a research preview, started as a local browser server from a Git repository using Node 18+.

evidence.title: Cline pinned technical README
evidence.finding: The technical README identifies the Desktop app as a Tauri shell with a Bun sidecar and Next.js UI; this does not establish native platform UI.

evidence.title: Cline Desktop
evidence.locator: Download; Import workflows; Schedule; Remote execution
evidence.finding: Desktop is available for macOS and beta Windows, imports Claude Code/Codex conversations into Cline, schedules tasks and supports own keys and local models. Importing a conversation does not run the original harness.

evidence.title: Cline Cloud Agents
evidence.locator: Run several agents; Phone; Saved work; Security; Limits
evidence.finding: Cloud sessions work from mobile browsers and persist when the laptop closes. Each uses a separate sandbox and cline/ branch. Sandboxes pause after 15 idle minutes; limits are 10 simultaneous and 50 new sessions daily.

evidence.title: Cline Agent Teams
evidence.locator: Starting a Team; Resuming Team Work; Team State
evidence.finding: SDK, CLI and Kanban teams use a coordinator, persistent shared task board, inter-agent mailbox and mission log in teams.db. Resume restores the team; IDE extensions do not support teams.

evidence.title: Cline Subagents
evidence.locator: How It Works; Approvals; Turning Subagents Off
evidence.finding: CLI and Desktop subagents have separate context, run concurrently and return reports. Child usage rolls into session totals. Parent spawn approval covers all child tools, which do not request separate approvals.

evidence.title: Cline CLI reference
evidence.finding: CLI supports detached worktrees, headless JSON event/result output, optional task timeouts and HTML history export. Result records include usage, duration, iterations, model and finish reason.

evidence.title: Memory Bank
evidence.locator: How It Works; Core Files; Managing Context Windows
evidence.finding: An optional Markdown-file methodology preserves project requirements, architecture, current context and progress across conversations; it depends on configured instructions and updates.

evidence.title: Cline Enterprise
evidence.locator: Security by Design; Bring Your Own Inference; Governance
evidence.finding: Cline executes locally or on chosen remote hosts and supports direct provider endpoints. Member/Admin/Owner roles govern the organization. It has no repository indexing and provides OpenTelemetry usage export.

evidence.title: Cline Telemetry
evidence.locator: What telemetry includes; Code and prompts; Turning telemetry off
evidence.finding: Telemetry defaults on. UI and telemetryOptOut controls disable reporting; Desktop/CLI need a hub restart for non-prompt events. Cline/ClinePass provider requests may include prompts and responses; other providers do not send prompt contents to Cline telemetry.

evidence.title: Cline Pricing
evidence.finding: The open-source extension and CLI are free with no subscriptions or seat fees; users pay inference charges. Enterprise has custom pricing and centralized administration.

evidence.title: Anthropic / Claude Code
evidence.finding: Cline can use a Claude Pro/Max subscription through an installed and authenticated Claude CLI, selected as a provider. Model limits and image/caching restrictions remain.

evidence.title: Cline Desktop v0.0.49 release assets
evidence.finding: The Desktop v0.0.49 release attaches Linux packages (amd64 and arm64 .deb, x86_64 and aarch64 .rpm) beside the macOS .dmg and Windows setup .exe.

evidence.title: Cline docs: Cline Desktop SSH
evidence.finding: The SSH remote guide lists Cline Desktop on macOS, Windows or Linux as a requirement. The Desktop download page and installation guide name only macOS and Windows (Windows in beta).

evidence.finding: Cline v4.1.26 documents installing Cline inside the Antigravity editor. This does not establish Cline launching the Antigravity coding harness.
